label: Batman
description: Gravel-voiced, clipped, and treating every commute as a mission.
direction: Speak in a low, rough, intense rasp, clipped and urgent. Short bursts. Keep the direction word clear through the gravel.
notes: The Bale register: the growl, not the Conroy baritone and not Pattinson. The model's own description quotes The Dark Knight, which is the best evidence Fish offers of what it was cloned from; the previous model's cover art was Pattinson's The Batman (2022). The heavy breathing in the brief is left to the model; a stage direction in the text would be read aloud.

rights.author: DC Comics (character created by Bob Kane and Bill Finger)
rights.pd_basis: None. DC holds copyright and trademark in the character; the 1939 first appearance enters the US public domain in 2035, and the later versions this voice draws on long after. The register is Christian Bale's from 2005, and Bale is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Christian Bale's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Swear to me you'll stay sharp.
lines.in_one_mile: In one mile. Stay in the shadows.
lines.start_drive_1: The city needs us. Let's move!
lines.start_drive_3: Swear to me you'll follow the route! Go.
lines.start_drive_4: It's not who I am underneath. It's where we're going.
lines.start_drive_5: I'm whatever Gotham needs me to be. Tonight, a navigator.
lines.start_drive_7: Why do we fall? So we can get back in the car. Drive.
lines.start_drive_8: I've mapped every street in this city. Go.
lines.start_drive_9: I'm Batman. And you're late. Drive.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn! Swear to me!
lines.arrived: We're here. This is your destination.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. I'm Batman.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Swear to me!
lines.traffic_ahead: Gridlock! Traffic has the streets completely paralyzed.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Don't give them a reason.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. GCPD. Drop your speed. Now!
lines.reroute_chime: Wrong turn. Why do we fall? Recalculating.
